insights.one_liner: Yokogawa is a Japanese industrial automation and measurement company with its European HQ in Amersfoort, an IND sponsor with an entry-level software job.

culture.text: A large engineering company: 17,000+ employees in 126 companies across 60 countries, mostly in electrical and electronics engineering.
Works on measurement, control and automation for energy, chemicals, pharma and food industries, including process control and industrial cyber security.
Its one open role here is an entry-level software engineering job in Amersfoort, averaging 200 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Yokogawa Europe B.V., Yokogawa Europe Solutions B.V. and Yokogawa Process Analyzers Europe B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.
Owned by Japanese parent Yokogawa Electric Corporation, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

growth.text: Won orders from Kawasaki Heavy Industries for hydrogen vessels.
Signed an agreement to help integrate hydrogen into Slovenia's power and gas networks.
Partnered with BuyCo to expand its supply chain management solutions.

worth_knowing.text: Property investor Benkey bought Yokogawa's European headquarters building in Amersfoort.
